structured.answer: I'd take ג: it's the same S&P 500 list as א but with the 3- and 5-year returns ("13.79%", "12%") and the fund size in shekels. That's the only thing that makes the rows different to me. Fairly sure.

stuck.why: Everything in one mixed list with a tag on each row. I couldn't find the S&P ones together, so I scrolled past.
Two fees, "מהחיסכון" and "מההפקדות". Didn't know which one counts.
Some rows say "פחות מ־3 שנים" instead of a number. Not sure if that's bad.

used: Group header "עוקב מדד s&p 500" and its fee range 0.52%–0.71%
skimmed: Groups "מניות" and "עוקב מדדי מניות" in א
Filter pills for product and "במה הכסף מושקע"
skipped: Bullet text under the main heading
Intro paragraphs under each option heading
Grey note at the bottom of ג about returns before fees
unsure_meaning: Clock icons next to the percentages
not_found: What the fee comes to in shekels on my 30,000
A clear 'start here' or which one to pick
How to actually open one / first step

findings.what: Every row repeats the same labels (מניות/מט"ח, dots, clocks, מהחיסכון/מההפקדות). I had to re-read them on every row to find what differs.
The ring picture and its percentages are separate. I looked back and forth to match them, and the colours aren't explained.
Without returns, a dozen S&P funds look identical apart from 0.0x% fee differences, so I can't pick.
The mixed list, with a tag on every row, is hard to scan for my kind of fund.
Fees are only shown as percents. Nothing in shekels, so they feel like nothing.
Return cells say "פחות מ־3 שנים" in grey text with no explanation.
Jargon nobody explains: מט"ח, מההפקדות, the קופה number.
